rationale_one_line: A data_story about a confidence curve crossing an 'enough' threshold IS a receipt — RECEIPT's sparkline and count-up heroes fit the adaptive-crawl proof exactly, and the story needs measured evidence, not a manifesto or a dateline.
writing_tone_notes: Peer-to-peer, declarative, show-don't-tell. Lead the contrast (every page vs only what matters), let the confidence curve make the point, no superlatives. Contractions where natural.
do_rules: flip to crawl4ai's LIGHT identity (warm-paper canvas, teal accent) — clears the color gate on a canvas-value flip and answers the standing 'every video seems dark' note by construction
spend the one hero moment on the STOP (confidence crosses the line and the crawl halts), not a command demo
make the money shot an inverted dark teal-lit field so the light editorial run has a real value swing (color script)
carry two repo-study product beats (the selective crawl and the clean fit_markdown)
dont_rules: no terminal typing `crwl ...` (the killed default; terminal is off the table this run)
no messy-HTML-to-clean-markdown split as the thesis (that's the commodity every scraper claims)
at most one growth-metric beat (the 72k receipt); the mechanics carry the story
